QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Where Did Cygnus Go 3
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Lily at the Vacant Lot.
QuestInfo.1: You must eliminate the Motes swarming in the city, then head to Cygnus.
QuestInfo.2: Arenda's greed has turned her into a Greedy Troublemaker.\r\nIt looks like she was plotting to destroy the school. She will be brought to trial eventually, bringing this case to an end.
